verdict.rationale: Kimi's help index documents a first-party PPT assistant with template selection and smart layout, and an Agent that builds web pages with multi-round modification and sharing. Kimi Code agents can also edit local files. However, the evidence is only help-page headings, and none of it shows document creation, iterative editing of presentations, or file export. missing for 10: documented export/download of generated files, document (e.g. Word/report) creation, iterative multi-turn editing of presentations and documents specifically, in-depth docs beyond help-index titles, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export
